a: A description for the DLM lifecycle policy.
The ARN of an IAM role that is able to be assumed by the DLM service.
Specify the type of default policy to create. valid values are `VOLUME` or `INSTANCE`.
Region where this resource will be [managed](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/general/latest/gr/rande.html#regional-endpoints).
Whether the lifecycle policy should be enabled or disabled. `ENABLED` or `DISABLED` are valid values. Defaults to `ENABLED`.
Key-value map of resource tags. If configured with a provider `default_tags` configuration block present, tags with matching keys will overwrite those defined at the provider-level.
A map of tags assigned to the resource, including those inherited from the provider `default_tags` configuration block.
Indicates whether the policy should copy tags from the source resource to the snapshot or AMI. Default value is `false`.
How often the policy should run and create snapshots or AMIs. valid values range from `1` to `7`. Default value is `1`.
snapshot or AMI retention behavior for the policy if the source volume or instance is deleted, or if the policy enters the error, disabled, or deleted state. Default value is `false`.
Type of policy to create. `SIMPLIFIED` To create a default policy. `STANDARD` To create a custom policy.
The valid target resource types and actions a policy can manage. Specify `EBS_SNAPSHOT_MANAGEMENT` to create a lifecycle policy that manages the lifecycle of Amazon EBS snapshots.
The location of the resources to backup. If the source resources are located in an AWS Region, specify `CLOUD`. If the source resources are located on an Outpost in your account, specify `OUTPOST`.
Type of default policy to create. Valid values are `VOLUME` and `INSTANCE`.
A list of resource types that should be targeted by the lifecycle policy. Valid values are `VOLUME` and `INSTANCE`.
Specifies how long the policy should retain snapshots or AMIs before deleting them. valid values range from `2` to `14`. Default value is `7`.

A map of tag keys and their values. Any resources that match the `resource_types` and are tagged with _any_ of these tags will be targeted. Required when `policy_type` is `EBS_SNAPSHOT_MANAGEMENT` or `IMAGE_MANAGEMENT`.
A descriptive name for the action.
Target Region or the ARN of the target Outpost for the snapshot copies.
ARN of the AWS KMS key to use for EBS encryption. If this parameter is not specified, the default KMS key for the account is used.
To encrypt a copy of an unencrypted snapshot when encryption by default is not enabled, enable encryption using this parameter.
How often this lifecycle policy should be evaluated. `1`, `2`,`3`,`4`,`6`,`8`,`12` or `24` are valid values. Conflicts with `cron_expression`. If set, `interval_unit` and `times` must also be set.

The unit for how often the lifecycle policy should be evaluated. `HOURS` is currently the only allowed value and also the default value. Conflicts with `cron_expression`. Must be set if `interval` is set.
The source of the event. Currently only managed CloudWatch Events rules are supported. Valid values are `MANAGED_CWE`.
The snapshot description that can trigger the policy. The description pattern is specified using a regular expression.
The type of event. Currently, only `shareSnapshot` events are supported.
The IDs of the AWS accounts that can trigger policy by sharing snapshots with your account. The policy only runs if one of the specified AWS accounts shares a snapshot with your account.
Indicates whether to exclude volumes that are attached to instances as the boot volume. To exclude boot volumes, specify `true`.
Map specifies whether to exclude volumes that have specific tags.
List specifies the volume types to exclude.
Indicates whether to exclude the root volume from snapshots created using CreateSnapshots. The default is `false`.
Map specifies whether to exclude volumes that have specific tags.

Applies to AMI lifecycle policies only. Indicates whether targeted instances are rebooted when the lifecycle policy runs. `true` indicates that targeted instances are not rebooted when the policy runs.
A descriptive name for the action.
Indicates whether the policy should copy tags from the source resource to the snapshot or AMI. Default value is `false`.
A map of tag keys and their values. DLM lifecycle policies will already tag the snapshot with the tags on the volume. This configuration adds extra tags on top of these.

A map of tag keys and variable values, where the values are determined when the policy is executed. Only `$(instance-id)` or `$(timestamp)` are valid values. Can only be used when `resource_types` is `INSTANCE`.
The schedule, as a Cron expression. The schedule interval must be between 1 hour and 1 year. Conflicts with `interval`, `interval_unit`, and `times`. For details on valid Cron expressions, see here.
How often this lifecycle policy should be evaluated. `1`, `2`,`3`,`4`,`6`,`8`,`12` or `24` are valid values. Conflicts with `cron_expression`. If set, `interval_unit` and `times` must also be set.

The unit for how often the lifecycle policy should be evaluated. `HOURS` is currently the only allowed value and also the default value. Conflicts with `cron_expression`. Must be set if `interval` is set.
Specifies the destination for snapshots created by the policy. To create snapshots in the same Region as the source resource, specify `CLOUD`.
A list of times in 24 hour clock format that sets when the lifecycle policy should be evaluated. Max of 1. Conflicts with `cron_expression`. Must be set if `interval` is set.
The SSM document that includes the pre and/or post scripts to run. In case automating VSS backups, specify `AWS_VSS_BACKUP`.
Indicates whether Amazon Data Lifecycle Manager should default to crash-consistent snapshots if the pre script fails. The default is `true`.
Indicates the service used to execute the pre and/or post scripts. If using custom SSM documents or automating application-consistent snapshots of SAP HANA workloads, specify `AWS_SYSTEMS_MANAGER`.

Specifies a timeout period, in seconds, after which Amazon Data Lifecycle Manager fails the script run attempt if it has not completed. In case automating VSS Backups, omit this parameter. The default is `10`.
Specifies the number of times Amazon Data Lifecycle Manager should retry scripts that fail. Must be an integer between `0` and `3`. The default is `0`.
List to indicate which scripts Amazon Data Lifecycle Manager should run on target instances. Pre scripts run before Amazon Data Lifecycle Manager initiates snapshot creation.
